blocks.text: The Land Transportation Office's Intelligence and Investigation Division (LTO-IID) has recommended a one-year suspension on the driver's license of the motorcycle rider involved in a hit-and-run of 'It's Showtime' host Cianne Dominguez's car in Antipolo City recently.
